q: Give me the total analysis till this month of October , full funnel analysis
answer:
Month-to-date (1–14 Oct, partial): net sales ₹1,148,200 (+75.0% vs prior period) on 609 orders, but we’re loss-making — net profit is −₹107,690 (a swing of −₹163,752) as ad spend jumped sharply.

- Sales & acquisition: Net sales ₹1,148,200 (+₹491,958, +75.0%); Orders 609 (+250, +69.6%); New customers 394 (+188, +91.3%). (commerce, order-date)
- Spend & efficiency: Ad spend ₹741,780 (+₹448,209, +152.7%) — spend rose faster than sales, pressuring margins. (paid_media, report_date)
- Profitability: Net profit (P&L basis) −₹107,690 vs prior +₹56,062, a −₹163,752 decline — the business turned loss-making despite higher sales. (order_pnl)
- Funnel health: Add-to-cart rate 2.9% (−4.6%) and conversion rate 0.9% (−5.2%) vs prior period — site engagement and conversion are slightly weaker even as traffic/orders grew. (web_sessions)

Worth checking: ad spend by platform/campaign next — to see which spends rose and whether they delivered profitable orders.

Period: 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-14 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
